Usage

[edit | edit source]
Item
Enchanted Clock
Effects

Ability: Time Warp RIGHT CLICK
Advance time by 1 hour!

Impacts your Minions, Chocolate Factory, Aging Items, Kat, Fann, Greenhouse, and The Forge.
Cooldown: 48h

When used, the Enchanted Clock gives the player the option to advance either Minions, Chocolate Factory, Fann Timer, Kat Timer, Aging Items, Forge, or Greenhouse. Each of those can be activated separately from all others, after which that particular option goes on cooldown for 48 hours. If a member of one's co-op uses this item to speed up Minions, it goes on cooldown for all of the co-op's members. If the Kat, Fann or Forge slots are all empty, or if there are no crops planted in any Greenhouse plots, then those options cannot be activated. The Minions boost can only be used if the player is on their  Private Island, and the Greenhouse boost can only be used if the player is on  The Garden.

Interface

[edit | edit source]
Enchanted Time Clock

Notes

[edit | edit source]
  • Using Enchanted Clock on Chocolate Factory while Time Tower perk is active will not affect its duration or cooldown.
  • Using this item on Minions results in offline calculations being performed, however any minion buffs provided by Pets also apply if the player is on the island and has them equipped.
  • Using this item on Minions with temporary fuels will remove 1 hour of its duration.
  • The  Time Pocket doubles the 1 hour time skip granted by this item.

Game Messages

[edit | edit source]
Condition Message
Using Time Warp
TIME WARP! You have successfully warped time for your <time warp type>!
Attempting to use a Time Warp that is on cooldown
TIME NOPE! This action is currently on cooldown! (Cooldown: <remaining time>)
Attempting to use Minions Time Warp outside of your  Private Island
TIME NOPE! You need to be on your private island to use this!
Attempting to use Pet Training Time Warp with no active training sessions
TIME NOPE! Didn't time warp any Training Sessions- you don't have any!
Attempting to use Pet Sitting Time Warp without a pet being taken care of
TIME NOPE! You have no pet being taken care of by Kat- so no time warp!
Attempting to use Pet Sitting Time Warp when pet is finished
TIME NOPE! Your pet being taken care of by Kat has already finished upgrading its rarity!
Attempting to use Forge Time Warp with no items in the Forge
TIME NOPE! You didn't have any active Forge Items to speed up!
Attempting to use Greenhouse Time Warp outside of  The Garden
TIME NOPE! You need to be on your Garden to use this!
Attempting to use Greenhouse Time Warp with nothing planted
TIME NOPE! Nothing is currently growing in your Greenhouse. Plant something first!
